title: Göbekli Tepe datable because it was buried

tellings.quote: GOC teepe was dated the only reason they were able to date gockley teepe is because the site was believed to be buried

plain: Göbekli Tepe is an ancient stone site in Turkey, and the claim is that it could only be dated because the site is believed to have been buried. A researcher named Matt LaCroix says this in passing, without naming a source, in an episode about something large that he and Michels think happened around 12,000 BC. If he is right, the burial is the one thing that let anyone put an age on the place at all.
